plot_summary: Tony Stark, who harbors negative feelings about his emotionally distant father, travels back in time and meets a younger version of him. Disguised, Tony has a conversation with his father, Howard, who is nervously awaiting the birth of his own son. This encounter gives Tony a new perspective, allowing him to see his father's love and insecurities, leading to a moment of reconciliation and understanding. The clip concludes with an old video of Howard telling Tony he is his greatest creation.
